name: openapi-compatibility
description: Turn paired OpenAPI exports or an exported diff into a consumer-impact matrix and migration checklist. Use when you ask whether old clients will still work, which consumers a contract change affects, or what must change before an API upgrade. Works with pasted YAML, JSON, change reports and supplied consumer notes. Separates request acceptance, response guarantees, generated-client concerns and runtime evidence. Not for validating one specification, generating SDKs, writing release notes or deploying API changes.
